rejected_rule.statement: The allocation of lots in a partition action is similar to the distribution of assets among partners.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: A PPEAL from a decree of the Supreme Court. W. A Barton, K. C. , and Handoo , for the respondents. December 11, 1945. ( Delivered by LORD THANKERTON.) The allocation of lots in a partition action is similar to the distribution of assets among partners.
